verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a tax agency with machine-readable open-data rails could publish versioned APIs and a deprecation policy. The pack contains no such evidence. The only programmatic surface is a keyless Socrata SODA query on data.texas.gov, and nothing documents API versioning or deprecation for it. All OpenAPI/Swagger probe paths returned 404, and Webfile sits behind an authenticated eSystems session.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
